subject: Temporary retention waiver / backup purge hold - Clearwell Health
messages:
From: procurement@clearwell.com
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-02-14T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Request: temporary hold on backup purge for forensic review

Hi Jordan,

We discovered discrepant logs tied to a recent integration test and Legal has asked us to preserve related backups and logs while they complete a review. Can Redwood delay the scheduled backup purge for the Clearwell tenant (account HW-4827) for 7 days and confirm what evidence you can export (KV logs, snapshot references, and a list of storage locations)? We attached a short form with the request.

This is time-sensitive; please confirm by EOD Pacific.

Thanks,
Samir Rao
Procurement & Ops
Clearwell Health
Attachments: Clearwell_Retention_Request_Form.pdf
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-02-14T10:03:00-08:00
Subject: Fwd: Request: temporary hold on backup purge for forensic review

Forwarding Clearwell's request — they want a 7-day delay to the purge for HW-4827. Can ops confirm what's feasible and what artifacts we can provide quickly? Kimberly / Karthik, flags on DPA implications or required amendments? Laura, any security concerns with providing snapshot exports to an external retention list?

Suggested stopgap: hold purge for 72 hours while we scope and provide a proposed list of exports; escalate if legal needs longer. Need a single owner for the response to Clearwell.

-Jordan
Director, Sales (Enterprise)
Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-02-14T13:20:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Request: temporary hold on backup purge for forensic review

Jordan / team,

Operational note: Clearwell's scheduled purge for their snapshot set (snapset: hw4827-prod-202702) runs nightly at 03:00 UTC. We can intervene and pause the purge immediately; the simplest option is to flip a tenant-level retention flag for 7 days and export a trimmed KV-log snapshot now.

Quick answers:
- Artifacts we can provide within 24 hours: KV log export (CSV, ~12MB), latest snapshot manifest (JSON), storage object list (S3 keys).
- Forensically-sound export: we can create an immutable export bundle and transfer to their SFTP or to our secure Drive export folder.
- Impact: a 7-day temporary hold increases retained storage costs negligibly; longer holds require manual bookkeeping and a follow-up ticket to Finance.

Attachments: kvlog-snapshot-20270214.csv (sample), I can produce the full export if legal signs off on transfer. Recommend: implement immediate 72-hour hold, prepare export bundle, and route to legal for approval of longer hold.

—Marissa
Senior Ops Engineer, Inference Platform
Redwood Inference
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-02-15T09:45:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Request: temporary hold on backup purge for forensic review

Team,

Legal review: a short-term retention waiver (stopgap) is acceptable provided we document the exception and obtain a signed amendment if Clearwell requests retention beyond 7 days. Requirements:
- Clearwell must sign the retention waiver (I attached a fillable waiver template).
- All exported artifacts must be logged to our Exception Registry with timestamps and approver initials.
- We need confirmation of the destination for exports (SFTP vs Drive). If we transfer to their SFTP, get a PO/ack from BackupCo or the subprocessor team (FastCache) that they will not process beyond the scope.

Karthik: please confirm whether the DPA needs any quick addendum language for cross-border transfer if they ask to move artifacts outside the US.

Kimberly Park
Senior Counsel, Privacy & Security
Redwood Inference
Attachments: waiver-template.docx
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: procurement@clearwell.com
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, ops@backupco.io
Date: 2027-02-18T16:05:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Request: temporary hold on backup purge for forensic review

Samir — thanks for the request and the form. Quick update and next steps: 

- We have applied a temporary 7-day hold on the scheduled purge for your snapshot set (hw4827-prod-202702). That hold is effective immediately.

> On 2027-02-14, Marissa noted we can produce: KV log export (CSV), latest snapshot manifest, and an object list. Marissa will create an immutable export bundle.

- Deliverables: Marissa will upload an encrypted export bundle to the Drive folder linked below and can also push to your SFTP if you provide host/credentials. We will log the export in Redwood's Exception Registry and include a signed waiver before any retention beyond 7 days.

- Legal: Kimberly has provided a waiver template; please sign and return via DocuSign. Karthik will confirm if any DPA addendum is necessary should you request cross-border transfer.

Links: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-clearwell-evidence (export location)
HubSpot ticket: tkt-CH-1184

We will follow up with the export artifacts within 24 hours of your confirmation of destination. Please confirm preferred transfer method (SFTP or Drive) and whether you require the export bundle to be delivered to FastCache (subprocessor) for your internal intake.

-Jordan Blake
